title: senna sophera var. penghuana
intro: Senna sophera var. penghuana, commonly known as Penghu senna, is a plant species in the legume family. It is a variant of the Senna sophera plant, known for its medicinal properties and traditional use in folk medicine. The health benefits of Penghu senna include its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include purgation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins.
